newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic adds stents in overseas markets.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic adds stents in overseas markets.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Thursday it has released in Europe and other overseas markets two additional sizes of its beStent coronary stent.
The company said it will now offer the beStent in eight and 25 millimeters, as well as the 15 millimeter length introduced to international markets last November.
Coronary stents are used to support artery walls during angioplasty procedures.

"The initial release of the beStent device in markets outside the United States generated strong customer response," B. Kristine Johnson, president of Medtronic's vascular business, said in a statement. "We expect this extension of our beStent offering to generate similar strong interest among physicians."
